explanation: Requirements generated WITH clarification show significant improvement across all RE criteria. Clarification helped eliminate vague phrases found in the initial set (e.g., 'rapidly without causing significant latency', 'high enough to establish trust') and incorporated explicit parameters directly into the main requirement statements. Key additions include explicit weighting hierarchies(skills > work exp > project exp), concrete evaluation factors for project strength, explicit bias-mitigation rules regarding company reputation and proxy variables, system execution details (batch/asynchronous processing), and project timeline constraints (8-week MVP deployment).
